actual_scope: Prove the sharp continuous-concentration threshold for strict row dominance of the nearest-grid cyclic Gaussian family, uniformly in every retained bandwidth at least two.
scope_change_reason: The formal-interface card is used for a written analytic interface theorem rather than proof-assistant formalization. This original changed-concentration question targets the cost of Gaussian normalization and a matching obstruction, not a predecessor audit or the separately reserved production-rowgap question.
bottleneck_link: Concentration drives normalization and conditioning allowances in the retained physical Gaussian interface. A sharp necessary/sufficient threshold identifies a possible reduction and the obstruction that any such change must respect; no complete caller price or kappa improvement is asserted.
stop_rule: Ship the first proved new threshold with exact finite controls; leave reduced-concentration physical integration and lower-order refinements open.
evidence: PROOF.md proves the uniform asymptotic threshold. verify.py checks 522 geometry equalities, 336 full band rows with 4368 retained entries, 231 concentration/period pairs, opposite dominance outcomes and a false-admission control.
